Keep every row in order. Preserve all [[I]], [[B]], [[SC]] emphasis markers, [[BR]] markers and explicit source line counts. Do not return hashes; the host binds immutable hashes.", "context": {"title": "Gulliver's Travels", "unit": 43, "heading": "CHAPTER X.", "previous_rows": [{"source_id": "en99-043-0008", "target": "Здесь я должен заметить читателю, что постановление общего собрания в этой стране выражается словом [[I]]хнхлоайн[[/I]], которое означает увещание, насколько я могу его передать; ибо они не имеют понятия о том, как разумное существо можно принуждать, а не только советовать ему или увещевать его; потому что никто не может ослушаться разума, не отказавшись от права называться разумным существом.", "source_sha256": "97251ed3ee9e64eb23ac5c6e38decc7e537509efcb65cf412b85d07dfe7b5c62", "target_id": "ru-en99-043-0008", "tag": "p", "target_sha256": "43c1c9d0ad1c2456153c5cf47a5b0001113b84e662ef28296c5580eddde9d741"}, {"source_id": "en99-043-0009", "target": "Речь моего хозяина поразила меня глубочайшей скорбью и отчаянием; и, не в силах вынести охватившие меня муки, я упал без чувств к его ногам. Когда я пришёл в себя, он сказал мне, «что решил, будто я умер»; ибо эти существа не подвержены подобным слабостям природы. Я ответил слабым голосом, «что смерть была бы слишком большим счастьем; что, хотя я не могу порицать ни увещание собрания, ни настойчивость его друзей, всё же, по моему слабому и порочному суждению, я полагал, что было бы согласно с разумом проявить меньшую суровость; что я не могу проплыть и лье, а ближайшая к их стране земля, вероятно, лежит дальше чем за сто; что многих материалов, необходимых для постройки малого судна, которое унесло бы меня отсюда, в этой стране совершенно нет; но я всё же попытаюсь это сделать, из повиновения и благодарности его милости, хотя и заключаю, что дело это невозможное, и потому уже считаю себя обречённым на гибель; что несомненная перспектива неестественной смерти — наименьшее из моих зол; ибо, положим, я спасу жизнь каким-нибудь странным приключением, — как мог бы я спокойно думать о том, чтобы проводить свои дни среди [[I]]йеху[[/I]] и вновь впадать в мои старые пороки за неимением примеров, которые вели бы меня и удерживали на путях добродетели? Что я слишком хорошо знаю, на каких прочных основаниях покоятся все решения мудрых [[I]]гуигнгнмов[[/I]], чтобы они могли быть поколеблены доводами моими, жалкого [[I]]йеху[[/I]]; и потому, принеся ему смиренную благодарность за предложение помощи его слуг в постройке судна и попросив разумного срока для столь трудной работы, я сказал ему, что постараюсь сохранить своё жалкое существование; и если когда-нибудь вернусь в Англию, то не без надежды быть полезным моему собственному роду, воспевая хвалу славным [[I]]гуигнгнмам[[/I]] и предлагая их добродетели в пример подражания человечеству».", "source_sha256": "17556192d6c3dcf0a707bc6f26aa58b4ee8046ce635ec6908149e7d689c94173", "target_id": "ru-en99-043-0009", "tag": "p", "target_sha256": "5aef925b6dff9749b2c315d5aadeb0904237cbd67c7a509a41fb11295f5ded04"}], "source_language": "English", "part": 4, "book": null, "chapter": 10, "role": "PRINCIPAL_CHAPTER"}, "source_rows": [{"id": "en99-043-0010", "tag": "p", "text": "My master, in a few words, made me a very gracious reply; allowed me the space of two months to finish my boat; and ordered the sorrel nag, my fellow-servant (for so, at this distance, I may presume to call him), to follow my instruction; because I told my master, “that his help would be sufficient, and I knew he had a tenderness for me.”", "sha256": "a689864977c413912c8465ee45ded736b30f5400daac7126ef7f09e39a77d179", "role": "paragraph", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[45]/p[10]", "source_html_sha256": "a043a0c7c1efafbc66647bb833408ac7a1d3add23d63f9e5b32b36270ecb5f0f", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "br_count": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": null, "source_container_role": null}, {"id": "en99-043-0011", "tag": "p", "text": "In his company, my first business was to go to that part of the coast where my rebellious crew had ordered me to be set on shore. I got upon a height, and looking on every side into the sea, fancied I saw a small island toward the north-east. I took out my pocket glass, and could then clearly distinguish it above five leagues off, as I computed; but it appeared to the sorrel nag to be only a blue cloud: for as he had no conception of any country beside his own, so he could not be as expert in distinguishing remote objects at sea, as we who so much converse in that element.", "sha256": "004f5430f76dbf978970b09dc5590e9b01520ebadc8a9b165b76cc19fba2fbb7", "role": "paragraph", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[45]/p[11]", "source_html_sha256": "6b8e70b167fcf5323a41639078f2982e40c716ab7db1ccd266c51c5b9c6f9a9e", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "br_count": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": null, "source_container_role": null}, {"id": "en99-043-0012", "tag": "p", "text": "After I had discovered this island, I considered no further; but resolved it should, if possible, be the first place of my banishment, leaving the consequence to fortune.", "sha256": "af7eedd323275a6b7e6310d6d9b72cd503a3bd82de94692d659c6bb4ba344788", "role": "paragraph", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[45]/p[12]", "source_html_sha256": "5a4c07883843b125ccdeec06c3502c9560eb2eb168fe404f9ab183f504758f28", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "br_count": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": null, "source_container_role": null}, {"id": "en99-043-0013", "tag": "p", "text": "I returned home, and consulting with the sorrel nag, we went into a copse at some distance, where I with my knife, and he with a sharp flint, fastened very artificially after their manner, to a wooden handle, cut down several oak wattles, about the thickness of a walking-staff, and some larger pieces. But I shall not trouble the reader with a particular description of my own mechanics; let it suffice to say, that in six weeks time with the help of the sorrel nag, who performed the parts that required most labour, I finished a sort of Indian canoe, but much larger, covering it with the skins of [[I]]Yahoos[[/I]], well stitched together with hempen threads of my own making. My sail was likewise composed of the skins of the same animal; but I made use of the youngest I could get, the older being too tough and thick; and I likewise provided myself with four paddles. I laid in a stock of boiled flesh, of rabbits and fowls, and took with me two vessels, one filled with milk and the other with water.", "sha256": "71dfcc261041d64a0eacfcf138a187c066650b7f75450f7b6313b25b19c2d0b7", "role": "paragraph", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[45]/p[13]", "source_html_sha256": "766596499209d51531cc7263ba63590d852613906dc0eba9b26585adacb25823", "emphasis_spans": 1, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "br_count": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": null, "source_container_role": null}, {"id": "en99-043-0014", "tag": "p", "text": "I tried my canoe in a large pond, near my master’s house, and then corrected in it what was amiss; stopping all the chinks with [[I]]Yahoos’[[/I]] tallow, till I found it staunch, and able to bear me and my freight; and, when it was as complete as I could possibly make it, I had it drawn on a carriage very gently by [[I]]Yahoos[[/I]] to the sea-side, under the conduct of the sorrel nag and another servant.", "sha256": "c620abe5771c4e0f5b2c7ca71f35b604b2e80e3d21501837105351003397c6b4", "role": "paragraph", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[45]/p[14]", "source_html_sha256": "2e220159a35252cd2ec59c39bfd3d68d64fa47226357fa78def158b20d1f85c5", "emphasis_spans": 2, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "br_count": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": null, "source_container_role": null}, {"id": "en99-043-0015", "tag": "p", "text": "When all was ready, and the day came for my departure, I took leave of my master and lady and the whole family, my eyes flowing with tears, and my heart quite sunk with grief. But his honour, out of curiosity, and, perhaps, (if I may speak without vanity,) partly out of kindness, was determined to see me in my canoe, and got several of his neighbouring friends to accompany him. I was forced to wait above an hour for the tide; and then observing the wind very fortunately bearing toward the island to which I intended to steer my course, I took a second leave of my master; but as I was going to prostrate myself to kiss his hoof, he did me the honour to raise it gently to my mouth. I am not ignorant how much I have been censured for mentioning this last particular. Detractors are pleased to think it improbable, that so illustrious a person should descend to give so great a mark of distinction to a creature so inferior as I. Neither have I forgotten how apt some travellers are to boast of extraordinary favours they have received. But, if these censurers were better acquainted with the noble and courteous disposition of the [[I]]Houyhnhnms[[/I]], they would soon change their opinion.", "sha256": "69bc7052884fd0b537728a340327cfa95b76eb2838a52f65b2a9d8736792986d", "role": "paragraph", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[45]/p[15]", "source_html_sha256": "dc435e4b5819cf6010c4354e62b32524a07a584826530002d65d93897502779c", "emphasis_spans": 1, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "br_count": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": null, "source_container_role": null}, {"id": "en99-043-0016", "tag": "p", "text": "I paid my respects to the rest of the [[I]]Houyhnhnms[[/I]] in his honour’s company; then getting into my canoe, I pushed off from shore.", "sha256": "b70985edf7a010238a98b5756e3f2a87a2c929b054d9d92d9b5bb233d555d932", "role": "paragraph", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[45]/p[16]", "source_html_sha256": "3b1c2e5949f7533adfa4accab204d0927944431b486a54089f2a2b7c9c896567", "emphasis_spans": 1, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "br_count": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": null, "source_container_role": null}]}
